test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MARS' is written as '51' and 'COLD' is written as '34'. How will 'ACID' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'MARS' is written as '51'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0df4b58486f5c68aee1a0409f9a0cfc8ccf4766cc7babc0492bbaa73226a550.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03c1ed0f5b657da2dd3db636fdbe611e24351afa123bf93768e438ad5aca9709.png] 

And,

 
• 'COLD' is written as '34'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bffe8c1d7e3469a79e355de7b4ee712e623d078d5c1b7c978c6c886d1c1fb4b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a52cf390c9e0a3ff3397311be1662be0baa4f2874adfbb58ccb878d48922ef18.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'ACID' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/370d2054bcee1a2877f6f19fb0c9a2483f4dd5ed2dc6585cc4291e07f3b2d854.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43abab7545100841534d1cf7fa57906d2c8ad7d118ca94e3bc28c690c8d94f90.png] 

Hence, "17" is the correct answer.
